gen-gf-grandstander-gf-readex-pro: Loud but friendly letters, held open rather than curled shut: that is Grandstander up top, with a tall x-height and short ascenders. Readex Pro follows with broad gaps at its terminals, a steady weight that keeps a full page of text moving smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Flavors is wiry and whimsical, with a towering x-height. Noto Sans Tagalog sits underneath it as a plain sans with generous curves, so the quirky heading gets a quiet, sturdy partner to lean on.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads like bent copper pipe, with big open eyes and curves that stop short of closing. Paprika above it scatters its letters wide and fills the line like capitals, so the two feel like loud and brisk neighbors.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding, tube-like strokes mark Tilt Neon, with a splayed c and short ascenders. TikTok Sans then runs on with a tall x-height and open curves, so paragraphs read smoothly without crowding.
gen-fs-chubbo-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, with broad openings in every bowl-ended curve. And Chubbo, drawn as if with a marker tip, does its best work being casual and inviting, while the slab-serif keeps the detail crisp.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sono: Sono reads tall and widely spaced, each lowercase a with its mouth left ajar. And Unica One, drawn like thin steel rod with daylight in every curve, grabs attention, while the plain sans carries the quieter work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sofia-sans-semi-conde: Wallpoet lets paper show between its letters. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed follows in a steady, unvarying line, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so long text reads tidily and cleanly.
gen-megrim-gf-sulphur-point: Angular, futuristic, hairline sharp: that is Megrim. Sulphur Point answers with a sturdy sans-serif and bulky lowercase, so try the body a size or two larger than you would expect.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-quicksand: Oswald is tightly knit and confident. Quicksand has rounded bulb-like bowls and monoline strokes, and it does its best work staying soft and approachable while the heading handles the strong statements.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-akatab: Tight, strong rows of letters define Oswald. Akatab has round, cupped shapes in its sans body, so if the heading shrinks or the body grows large, that gentle feel starts to dominate.
